notes: Both object markers are unrepresented under rule 16 — the ASV writes the objects bare, and the suffix of `אֹתוֹ` takes the *him*.
The construct `מִצְוֺת` carries no article morpheme, so the supplied *the* joins it under rule 29 while `יְהוָה` takes the relational *of* under rule 19.
Each `לְ` before an infinitive construct takes the written *to* (rule 52).
